summary: Scope degraded naming reads to the conflicting claim component, including competing identities and nested references.

replay.detail: The canonical naming reducer and measured 64-claim refold cap are unchanged.

schema.detail: Add forward-only partial from/to indexes on naming claims so failure scope derives from indexed durable claims rather than the cached naming fold.

rules.detail: Above-cap conflicts fence affected subjects, former/destination names and all connected claimants. Scope discovery hydrates at most 64 indexed rows, including repeats; unavailable proof falls back to global fencing. Unrelated names retain their last-fold resolution, with degradation visible in existing store health and doctor.

compatibility.detail: No ResolvedIdentity or wire format changes.

manual.detail: Degraded rows list affected names and instruct: run fractal replication replay --confirm in a planned window. The operator command must land before this change rolls out.

recovery.detail: Persist all outstanding conflicting operations and refresh scoped proofs after new claims; explicit replay clears degradation. Nested typed references use the same scoped failure boundary.

downtime.detail: The two new partial indexes are built during store initialization; no production index-build timing is claimed.
